implementation.pass: finishMerge now walks template blocks per pass with a record pointer; a NEXT field advances the pointer for following blocks and records used in the pass
implementation.pageBreak: one page break per template pass, not per record; multiple records can appear on one page when NEXT is used
implementation.nextStart: the next pass starts after the last record used by the previous pass
implementation.cleanup: NEXT gate removed from UI and checkMergeErrors
